query:
SELECT 
  s.name,
  s.feePerQuarter,
  s.venue,
  s.scheduleDay,
  s.scheduleTime
FROM students s
WHERE s.id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.id 
  FROM students st
  JOIN dojos d ON (
    st.venue = d.name AND 
    st.scheduleDay = d.schedule_day AND 
    st.scheduleTime = d.schedule_time
  )
  WHERE d.coach_name = '賴政堡'
)
LIMIT 10;
